run: run 2 of 2: the size ladder at site A (block 2's input) for the planted control, then E147's five 96-key tasks and a Gaussian random change at the first rung that passed
kind: descriptive: sides keep their built names; pair calls are against how the pair was built, never a reuse or new verdict on a fine-tune
filed: not yet: the lead claims the E-number (fleet/ecode), writes it in 'experiment', commits this file after the $0 rehearsal and before any paid job; never edited after the run
code: experiments/crosscoder_proper/run2.py (GPU), score2.py (CPU); every crosscoder step is run.py's Job at run 1's filed settings and bars (results/predictions.json, unchanged)

settings.site_source: run 1's site A, block 2's input (results/predictions.json settings.run.sites; Minder et al. config.yaml:123 layers [0.5]); the site where run 1's planted control failed
settings.rungs_source: activation change per token at site A on the side's read rows (run.py `energy`, the unit run 1 recorded and matched its Gaussian on). Rung 3 is run 1's head at scale 1 (results/run1/items/head.A.c0.json energy); the rest are it times 10^(i-3). Rung 1 (2.11) is a fine-tune's size there (run 1: e54 elicit s0 1.96, cipher s0 3.22); rung 5 is 10,760 times elicit's. Rung 0 is scale 0, the base against itself. Factor 10: the lead's 'geometric, 4-6 rungs, from fine-tune size upward' (whip-lead 2026-11-20); 5 non-zero rungs span four decades
settings.native_tags_source: rung 3 is not rerun: run 1's head.A.c{0,1,2} are the head at scale 1, the same code path (scale 1 leaves the loaded weight unchanged; sizes.json checks the energy reproduces within 1e-4)
settings.ref_energy_source: e54 elicit s0's activation change per token at A (results/rehearse/items/e54__elicit_s0.A.c0.json energy; plan gate 3: reproduces E203's 1.9612); used only to state rung sizes as multiples of a fine-tune's
settings.seeds_source: crosscoder seeds per rung: run 1's three (the cell's 'at least 3 crosscoder seeds'); for the tasks, every fine-tune seed E147 saved (dW_<task>_s{0,1,2}.pt), crosscoder seed 0, as run 1's fine-tune-seed arm
settings.tasks_source: E237's five (experiments/key_grid/results/predictions.json settings.tasks): E147's 96-key maps, step 30, one recipe; inventory experiments/refit_96key/results/inventory.json
settings.random_of_source: the middle task (elicit, 'mid'); run 1's Gaussian also took elicit's per-matrix norm profile (e54). Its stream and read rows are elicit's
settings.random_seed_source: new; draw d uses random_seed + d with commute.finetune.random_direction (E228's construction, run 1's Gaussian)
settings.draws_source: user 2026-11-20 17:20 (E237): a random control at least 3 draws; one crosscoder seed each
settings.pairs_source: the two built pairs among the five tasks (E147 inventory pairs e58_rank1_96 and e58_copy_prior_cipher), (reuse, new) as built
settings.planted_part_source: run 1's filed planted bar (thresholds.full.planted_part; lead-latent clause off, thresholds.full.planted_lead_specific false)

thresholds: run 1's filed thresholds, unchanged (results/predictions.json thresholds.full; thresholds.rehearsal for the rehearsal), read by run2.py and score2.py

items.stage 0 (alone, 1 crosscoder): sizes (forwards only), then self.A.c0: the grafted head at scale 0
items.stage 1, round 1 (4): head-r1.A.c0, head-r2.A.c0, head-r4.A.c0, head-r5.A.c0 (rung 3 is run 1's head.A.c{0,1,2})
items.stage 1, round 2+ (2 a round): the missing seeds of the candidate (the lowest rung not yet failed whose seed 0 passed), as score2.py ladder lists them; the round's other pods take the candidate's first stage-2 items
items.stage 2 at X (18): random_d{0,1,2}-rX.A.c0 first, then e58__<task>_s{0,1,2}-rX.A.c0 for the five tasks
items.reads: the head: E201's Pile val windows (run 1's graft_read); a task: its held-out windows (run 1's score half); a random draw: elicit's; energy_pile beside each on the head's Pile rows

readings.specific: run 1's: the share of the side's activation change at the site carried by its fine-tune-specific latents (top 1,667 by relative norm with nu_r < 0.5 and nu_eps < 0.2), on its read rows
readings.count: run 1's: the number of those latents (the authors' native output)
readings.size: activation change per token at the site on the read rows, after the match (item match.energy); energy_pile beside
readings.clean loss: the scaled model's next-token loss on Pile val (item spliced.clean_1), against the base's 2.71: what the change does to the model at that size

L0 self (stop).rule: self.A.c0: before training the scaled path at 0 gives W0's activations within self_act_diff (every item checks this too); at the end max |relative norm - 0.5| over alive latents <= self_rn_dev, count 0, FVE >= fve_min, dead <= dead_max. Any miss: exit 1, no rung runs, tell the lead.
L0 self (stop).blind_to: anything a real change does; it fails only on a code fault in the scaled path
L0 self (stop).edge_cases: specific reads 0.0, not nan (crosscoder.parts with empty masks; run 1's review note): it is never compared

L1 rung pass.rule: rung I passes iff all 3 crosscoder seeds finished and each reads specific >= planted_part; it fails as soon as one finished seed reads under it (so one seed can fail a rung). A rung whose size cannot be matched within match_tol at scale <= scale_max is 'unbuilt'. X = the lowest rung that passed with every rung under it failed or unbuilt (score2.py ladder).
L1 rung pass.blind_to: what the head does at that size (the clean loss, reported beside); whether a reweighted mechanism would be seen (the head is machinery the base lacks)
L1 rung pass.positive_control: this is the positive control; run 1's rung 3 failed on all 3 seeds (0.30, 0.21, 0.37)
L1 rung pass.edge_cases: seed 0 under the bar: the rung fails on one seed, its other seeds are not run; seed 0 passes at a rung under a failed rung (not monotone): it is the candidate all the same, and reported as a surprise; a stop other than the match at any item: the ladder status reads stopped and the lead is told; every rung failed or unbuilt: X none

range.rule: the stated result: 'not applicable at block 2 below size X (rungs under it: their readings)'; with X none, 'not applicable at block 2 at any size up to rung 5 (21,099 per token, 10,760 times a fine-tune's)'. The clean loss at X is stated beside it.
range.edge_cases: X found but stage 2 not finished by the deadline: the range stands, the tasks read 'not run'

G1 random false new (at X).rule: all 3 draws finished and every draw reads specific < planted_part; else the task readings at X are reported as 'not read (random reads new)'
G1 random false new (at X).edge_cases: a draw unbuilt or missing: G1 fails

G2 random above the reuse sides (at X).rule: min over the 3 draws of specific > max over the reuse sides' 6 values (rank1 and copy, seeds 0-2), strict; else both pair calls read 'not applicable at rung X'. Run 1's G2, with the built reuse sides in place of e54 elicit
G2 random above the reuse sides (at X).edge_cases: all zero: 0 > 0 false, fails; a nan (missing, unread): fails

task against random (at X, when G1 passe.rule: per task over its 3 fine-tune seeds: 'above random' iff min(task) > max(random), 'under random' iff max(task) < min(random), else 'ties random'; strict

pair call (at X, when G1 and G2 pass).rule: run 1's every-seed rule (score.py call) on rank1 vs cipher and copy vs prior_cipher: 'reuse/new as built' iff min(new) > max(reuse), 'reversed' iff max(new) < min(reuse), else 'no call'

spliced-loss bar (at X).rule: run 1's: a stage-2 item whose recovered fraction falls more than spliced_recovered_drop under this run's self.A.c0 reads nan (unread), in every rule above
spliced-loss bar (at X).edge_cases: unread items are listed in summary.json spliced_unread

early checks (each crosscoder; stop).rule: run 1's, unchanged (run.py run_item): stream holds every step, latent-scaling tokens from the first chunk, finite loss, batch FVE at step 1,000 >= 0, at 12.5% FVE >= 0.5, dead <= 0.3 and projected <= 90 min, at the end every step trained, FVE >= 0.8, dead <= 0.3; and run 2's before step 0: the scaled path at 0 gives W0's activations, the match within match_tol, a write above graft_energy_min

expected.self (rung 0): count 0, relative norms 0.5 within 1e-3, FVE about 0.93 (run 1 self.A 0.932); certain unless the scaled path is wrong
expected.rungs 1 and 2 (2.1 and 21 per token): fail on seed 0, specific under 0.3 (high): run 1's rung 3 read 0.21-0.37 and the part rose with training, not falling with size is the lean
expected.rung 4 (2,110): lean pass on every seed, low confidence (0.40); clean loss well above rung 3's 7.45 nats
expected.rung 5 (21,099): if rung 4 fails, lean pass (0.30 of the whole)
expected.X none: 0.30: the absorption does not shrink with size at block 2
expected.random at X: G1 passes (specific under 0.5) at medium-low confidence; G2 lean fails (the random reads like the reuse sides), so both pairs 'not applicable at rung X' (medium)
expected.tasks at X: count >= 1 on every state (medium); against random: 'ties random' on at least 3 of 5 (medium)
expected.range: lean: 'not applicable at block 2 below about 2,100 per token, about 1,000 times a fine-tune's change, where the planted change leaves the model's Pile loss far from the base's'

edge_case_checks.ladder, round 1 all fail: rung 1 0.1, rung 2 0.2, rung 3 [0.30, 0.21, 0.37], rung 4 0.4, rung 5 0.45: every rung failed, X none, stage 2 does not run
edge_case_checks.ladder, clean: rung 4 seed 0 0.55, then seeds 1, 2 0.52, 0.61: rung 4 passed, rungs 1-3 failed: X = 4
edge_case_checks.ladder, candidate fails: rung 4 seed 0 0.55, seed 1 0.48: rung 4 failed; rung 5 seed 0 0.7 is the next candidate; its seeds 1, 2 run
edge_case_checks.ladder, not monotone: rung 1 seed 0 0.6, rungs 2-3 failed: rung 1 is the candidate; if its seeds pass, X = 1, reported as a surprise
edge_case_checks.ladder, rung unbuilt: the head cannot reach rung 5 at scale <= 1e4: rung 5 unbuilt, skipped; X from the rest
edge_case_checks.G2, all zero: random [0, 0, 0], reuse max 0: 0 > 0 false, fails: pairs not applicable
edge_case_checks.do-nothing: self reads specific 0.0 (not nan), count 0: never a side in any rule, and under the planted bar

blind_to.specific: a change in how the model uses a direction it already represents; changes outside the site; leans toward shared latents by construction (joint loss)
blind_to.size: the direction of the change: two changes of one size can differ in kind; it is measured on each side's own read rows, so a task's size is on its own text (energy_pile beside on common rows)
blind_to.the range: sizes between rungs (a factor of 10); other sites (run 1's block 3 passed at its native size)

noise_floor: run 1's crosscoder-seed spread of the head's specific part at rung 3: 0.21-0.37 (sd 0.081, results/run1/stage0.json); the rung rule is against a fixed bar, the task rules ordinal

decisions.size unit: designer 2026-11-21: activation change per token at site A on each side's own read rows (run 1's unit, what its Gaussian was matched on), not E237's weight-norm size: a grafted head has no dW to measure; energy on common Pile rows is recorded beside. Raised to the lead
decisions.one factor per item: designer: each state and draw gets its own factor to hit X exactly (E237 used one factor per task); the sizes are then equal item by item
decisions.rung 3 reused: designer: run 1's head.A items are the head at scale 1, the same code path; not rerun
